title: Bench: Singularity H3 turbo LoRA, shipped 8-step v1.0 vs ref2v 4-step v0.1 at 8 steps
description: Fabio 2026-10-29: Singularity was reportedly trained with lightx2v's minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16. A/B on the shipped minimax_h3_r2va_singularity.json, local bench under gpu_lease: arm A = shipped (8-step v1.0 768p LoRA, stage 1 10 steps), arm B = 4-step v0.1 LoRA at 8 steps (what users run; 4 steps ruins the audio). 16:9, two speaking characters from reference sheets, camera dollies out from close-up to wide to test face hold at distance. Deliverable: side-by-side (full + face detail), audio heard one panel at a time. Bench only, no app change.
